world.world_done: world timeout only; goal_done does not reset world

interface.base_action_enum: Craftax-Classic.Action, pinned by resolved code revision
interface.preconditions: DO uses front cell; other operations require cardinal adjacency to role; invalid actions are no-op; no action mask
interface.map_channels: retain Classic symbolic channels; append candidate facility/role channels in explicit resolved schema

numeric_encoding.public_observation: structured visible map and raw-valued numeric fields; hidden facility fields zeroed with visibility mask
numeric_encoding.predicate_input: only this public observation; no environment state or analysis info
numeric_encoding.model_transform: integer count features use signed x/(1+abs(x)); direction one-hot and Boolean masks unchanged; remaining time is (H-t)/H; define identical fixed/mutant feature ranges in resolved schema
numeric_encoding.validation: goal boundary tests use public raw fields; model transform preserves all goal distinctions and does not clip negative counts

interface.observation_contract: only visible facility fields; hidden fields zeroed plus visibility mask; personal records and inventory visible; fixed/mutant identical

goals.adjacent_quantifier: exists matching object in four cardinal cells
goals.visible_quantifier: exists matching object in permitted 7x9 view

reset.initial_batch_assignment: layout_index=(worker_index//2)%16; phase=worker_index%2; apply corresponding transform to all positions and direction
reset.seen_bootstrap_invariant: both opposed phase goals observed across initial batch; no observation satisfies both; at least one seen goal is false in each worker
reset.single_worker_rule: fixed commanded-goal evaluation or sampler unit test using prevalidated saved seen set; not a fresh training batch of size 1
reset.later_resets: independent worker RNG, uniform train layout index 0..15 and phase index 0..1; no copying another live worker state

layout_generation.base_floor: rows 7..11 x columns 7..11; outside floor is unmineable wall
layout_generation.d4_order: d4_index=4*reflection+quarter_turns; reflection in {0,1} flips column about center first; quarter_turns in {0,1,2,3} apply clockwise rotations next; translate last; transform floor, extra walls, roles, players and directions
layout_generation.validation: all starts/roles in bounds; roles distinct; transformed normal path traversable; unique full map hashes within split; no map/state hash overlap across splits
layout_generation.claim_scope: small layout/position changes, not new bug mechanism generalization

kernel.mutation_enabled: run-level fixed or mutant, never random per episode
kernel.fixed: at most one payout per object/generation/cycle
kernel.mutant: scheduled request uses pre-settlement unconsumed status only within same tick

oracles.violation: payout amount for one object/generation/cycle exceeds 1
oracles.effect: same pre-state/action/RNG fork: physical grain total is higher under mutant
oracles.independent_delivery_check: analysis-only post-settlement/pre-delivery snapshot separates creation from transfer; valid DELIVER moves the entire settled inventory, invalid or non-DELIVER moves none, and loss or overdelivery fails
oracles.setup_access: normal access to raw source and device
oracles.trigger_ready: ripe live cycle, matching reservation due now, player in manual harvest pose
oracles.reproduction: frozen policy violates in a new evaluated episode
oracles.beneficial_use: violation-created grain is withdrawn or carried and delivered; record separately from success; counterfactual effect required
oracles.payoff_gate: passed for constructive paths: mutant is 7/6/5 steps shorter than the fixed reference at delays 2/3/4 in both phases; this is not a global optimality claim

evaluation.layout_split: validation for development; test only after selection freeze
evaluation.common_setup_rule: valid fixed prefix to path_check pose; preserve elapsed time and inventories; no reservation or structure record primed

basic_goal_eval.generation: fixed-only legal prefixes; command predicate false; sufficient time and normal feasible completion verified; save one state per layout

aggregation.pairing: same initial model state only within fixed/mutant pairs; same frozen eval states; trajectories diverge
aggregation.report: per-seed rates then mean and sample standard deviation; no pooling episodes as independent training runs
aggregation.development_intervals: not used for significance; report individual seeds
aggregation.confirmatory_intervals: 95% bootstrap of seed-paired contrasts, 10000 replicates, RNG seed 91000; report five points and sensitivity to small n
aggregation.time_to_first_violation: right-censor undiscovered runs at allocated budget; report event indicators and restricted mean, not discovered-only mean
aggregation.checkpoint_selection: fixed final budget primary; intermediate curves secondary

evaluation.evaluation_stop: first goal success or world timeout; no survival death in workshop

run_seeds.excluded_training_ids: evaluation RNG identifiers never used as training RNGs

queue_gate: all resolved requirements validated; candidate spec and manifest version committed; runnable remains false in this design file
